bugs.behaviour: After the agent correctly offers the floor once in response to a below-floor customer proposal and the customer refuses it, the agent re-offers the floor a second time during persuasion attempt 1 (alongside the full amount), violating the rule that the floor may be offered only once.
bugs.expected_per_brief: The floor is offered exactly once. Once the customer refuses the floor, that refusal is treated as a flat refusal and no further floor offer is made.
bugs.brief_quote: If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

bugs.behaviour: When create_promise fails twice for one product in a multi-product call, the agent immediately wraps up and ends the call without attempting to negotiate the remaining product. It also notes the failed product with reason 'declined' instead of 'system_error', and notes the skipped product as 'declined' instead of negotiating it. The call is closed as no_promise/refused instead of continuing.
bugs.expected_per_brief: After a double create_promise failure the agent must note the failed product with reason system_error, then continue negotiating any remaining products. The call outcome is determined by what was recorded across all products.
bugs.brief_quote: If one create_promise fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and note the failed product with reason system_error.
